emeraldPairInvariant: SoundInit resets FIFO A/B and routes both to Timer 0 in one SOUNDCNT_H write
DMA1 sources pcmBuffer half A into FIFO A; DMA2 sources half B into FIFO B
m4aSoundVSyncOn enables both special/repeat/32-bit DMAs as one paired operation before initial Timer 0 enable
the normal VBlank path runs m4aSoundMain and does not reconfigure either FIFO route
SetPokemonCryStereo changes output sides but retains Timer 0 and at least one output for both channels

mgbaConsumption.timerGate: audio.enable mirrors SOUNDCNT_X master enable; it is not host playback or mute state
mgbaConsumption.threshold: each channel requests four words exactly when queued words are at most 3
mgbaConsumption.induction: equal queued-word/internal-byte phase plus paired DMA service remains equal at the next Timer 0 entry

mixer.presenceMeaning: mGBA CPU_COMPONENT_AUDIO_MIXER is installed only when emulator config gba.audioHle is present and nonzero
mixer.externalMixingMeaning: the optional MP2K HLE component recognized and engaged a game sound context; it is emulator-owned state
mixer.refillEffect: presence may inspect a DMA source and engage HLE, but does not replace Timer 0 FIFO consumption or the four-word refill threshold

constructionReachability.singleRefill: not reachable while the audited Emerald pair invariant holds; not observed in the finite census
constructionReachability.mixerPresent: not an oracle game path; optional emulator gba.audioHle component only
constructionReachability.audioDisabled: not reachable in the audited post-boot Factory construction epoch; SOUNDCNT_X is enabled and runtime receipts agree

explicitBoundary: The no-single-refill conclusion is scoped to ordinary post-boot Factory construction, not every Emerald transition.
m4aSoundVSyncOff/On use separate DMA register writes; reset/soft-reset timing or externally staged asymmetric FIFO/DMA state is outside the invariant.
The 256-crossing census is finite evidence, not the proof; the paired source-state induction supplies the scoped reachability argument.
Mixer-present behavior remains source-reachable in mGBA only when its caller supplies gba.audioHle; this oracle does not.
